'''Tandankin shipyards''' was a ship manufacturing facility of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] located on [[Tandankin]]. It was the manufacturer of the [[S-12 Blackbolt]], [[S-13 Sting]], and [[S-SC4 Bloodmark]] starfighters.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter]]'' {{1stm}}
